description: Role: Associate Product Manager Location: Gurugram & Bangalore About The Function The Domestic Hotels Product Team strives to delivering unparalleled experiences for customers seeking hotel accommodations. Our efforts are led by a profound understanding of customer challenges, extensive data analysis, and identification of root causes. From architecting powerful backend systems to creating intuitive, delightful user journeys, the function is shaping the future of Hotels making every booking effortless, personalized, and unforgettable. About The Role As a Product Manager, the responsibility will be to lead high-impact initiatives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. The role entails full ownership of the product lifecycle from concept and strategy to launch and ongoing enhancement while working closely with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with leading industry professionals and influence the creation of exceptional, customer-first experiences in the Hotels space. What will you be doing Define and drive the product vision and strategy for Domestic Hotels, aligning initiatives with growth, revenue, and customer experience goals. Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle — from strategy and roadmap to feature launches and post-launch optimization. Own and optimize scalable product systems to improve funnel efficiency, conversion, retention, and the post-sales consumer experience. Design seamless, high-impact experiences for consumers and accommodation partners across frontend and backend platforms. Collaborate with cross-functional teams — Revenue, Category, Supply, Design, and Technology — to deliver cohesive, high-impact product solutions. Leverage data, insights, and experimentation to solve core user and business problems at scale. Drive product adoption and engagement by applying deep empathy for customers and partners and iterating on the product experience. Lead product releases in collaboration with Engineering, Design, and QA to ensure quality and timely delivery. Define, track, and optimize key product KPIs across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue to maximize business impact. Continuously analyze market trends, customer feedback, and post-launch performance to refine the product roadmap and drive growth. Qualification & Experience Engineering or Management graduate from a reputed institute with 2-4 years of experience in a product management role for a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business or product. Product Management experience in B2C ecommerce product environment; good communication and stakeholder management skills is a must-have for this role. Key Success Factors for the Role Passion for data Passion for data and an exceptional ability to solve complex problems. High ownership High ownership and end-to-end problem-solving, with a strong knack for understanding consumer problems and a commitment to solving them. Strong technological know-how, Strong technological know-how, with an understanding of how technology impacts the product roadmap and development. Business-oriented mindset, Business-oriented mindset, consistently thinking about ROI, revenue, and overall business impact. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments, Ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments, collaborating closely with business management, engineering, and UI/UX teams. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Experience working with complex datasets Experience working with complex datasets using standard data analysis tools and techniques (proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL querying). Prior experience with Google Analytics/Omniture will be an added advantage.
title: Associate Product Manager (Hotels)

description: About Eaton Eaton is a global intelligent power management company helping customers manage energy more safely, efficiently and sustainably. Within Eaton's Distributed Power Quality (DPQ) business, Data Centers represent one of our fastest-growing and most strategic markets, driven by cloud computing, digitalization and Artificial Intelligence. What You’ll Do You will own the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management of Eaton's White Space portfolio across EMEA. You will identify market opportunities, define product requirements and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Sales and Operations teams across EMEA and North America to drive profitable growth and innovation in one of Eaton's most strategic segments. Product Scope The Portfolio Includes IT Racks & Accessories Rack PDUs Rack Power Solutions, including DC architectures Aisle Containment Systems POD Solutions Superstructure Solutions Data Center Monitoring & Management Software These solutions contribute to Eaton's Grid-to-Chip approach for modern cloud, colocation and AI-driven Data Centers. Key Responsibilities Define and execute product strategy and roadmap. Manage the product lifecycle from development to end-of-life. Own product profitability and support pricing strategy. Gather customer insights and monitor market trends. Identify growth opportunities and competitive differentiators. Define requirements for new product development initiatives. Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions. Support go-to-market activities and product launches. Partner with global teams to align product roadmaps. Provide product expertise for strategic customers and major opportunities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or related field. Experience in Product Management, Product Marketing or Business Development. Experience within the Data Center industry. Knowledge of Data Center infrastructure technologies. Experience with White Space solutions (racks, rack PDUs, containment, PODs, modular infrastructure or similar technologies) is highly desirable. Strong business and financial acumen. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a global matrix organization. Fluent English required. Why Join Eaton ? Join one of Eaton's fastest-growing strategic businesses. Help shape the future of AI-ready Data Center infrastructure. Work on high-impact products deployed globally. Collaborate with teams across EMEA and North America. Grow your career within a global leader in intelligent power management. All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.
title: Product Manager - Data Center White Space (EMEA)

description: Who We Are VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com. VML Luxembourg VML Luxembourg is one of the leading Amazon consulting agencies in Europe. Offering 360° services for Amazon, we have a diverse range of products and services in various sectors to ensure long-term sales growth, ranging from creating multilingual content and listings to all aspects of advertising, including sales promotion, PPC and programmatic campaigns. We are part of WPP, the world’s largest digital media agency, and manage WPP’s European Center of Excellence for Amazon (ACE) dedicated to maximising performance, driving sales and building brands on the Amazon platform. The Opportunity We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Client Lead for EMEA. This role is focused on delivering exceptional client service at the most senior levels while driving transformative growth across markets. As the primary senior contact for key clients, you will own the strategic vision, relationship development, and commercial growth agenda, working closely with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to deliver excellence. You will be at the forefront of building deeper and broader client engagements, advancing the adoption of new capabilities, and unlocking multi-market opportunities. Given the matrix style of Commerce, this role will act as a bridge between client leadership, commercial, and creative teams when developing our Marketplace and wider commerce capability. This role will be pivotal in shaping and delivering the vision for connected brands through VML, with a focus on capability building, collaboration, and market enablement to achieve transformative growth. What You’ll Be Doing Strategic Partnership & Growth Leadership: Own and grow senior-level client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor to C‑suite and executive stakeholders. Shape and lead long-term client growth strategies, ensuring alignment with both client objectives and VML’s vision. Drive multi-market growth by identifying and unlocking new opportunities across regions and service lines. Partner with the WPP network to create market-leading, contract-winning proposals for current and prospective clients. Ensure strategic reporting and insight delivery, maintaining full ownership of the client reporting process and its quality. Business Development & Senior Stakeholder Engagement Lead high-impact presentations and strategic discussions with senior client stakeholders, influencing decision-making and securing new investment. Oversee and guide RFP responses, ensuring they reflect strategic insight and competitive advantage. Negotiate contract terms with clients and communicate terms to internal stakeholders. Champion the adoption of new capabilities and services within client organizations. Market Enablement & Capability Building Collaborate with internal teams to integrate creative, commercial, and marketplace expertise into client strategies. Represent VML at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build visibility and relationships. Stay ahead of industry trends and competitive insights to inform client strategies. What We Want From You Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Digital Commerce, or a closely related field. An advanced degree in Management, Strategy, or Digital Transformation is considered a strong asset. Proven track record in achieving year-on-year growth through senior-level client engagement and strategic leadership. Exceptional strategic thinking and execution skills with a client-centric approach. Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with experience managing cross-functional teams and initiatives. Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a knack for crafting compelling growth narratives. Familiarity with the e‑commerce ecosystem, including content and advertising expertise, is a plus. Experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex, matrixed organizations. Proficiency in English is mandatory; French and/or German are a plus. What We Can Offer You Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are. AT VML Enterprise Solutions Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands. We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson & Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany & Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business. As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. VML is a WPP agency (NYSE: WPP). description: Job description : GTM & Outbound Growth Specialist (B2B Tech) Location: Bangalore Experience: 2+ Years About Blufig At Blufig, we help B2B technology companies build strong brands, generate demand, and drive revenue. We work exclusively with B2B tech companies including SaaS firms, software companies, IT services providers, and enterprise technology brands. Our team partners with companies across the globe to help them scale through brand strategy, demand generation, content, digital campaigns, and marketing automation. Over the years, we have helped 150+ technology brands improve their visibility, generate qualified leads, and accelerate business growth. We are a team of strategists, marketers, creators, and technologists who believe marketing should ultimately drive measurable business outcomes. About the Role This Is Not a Typical Marketing Role. We are looking for someone who can build and run outbound growth engines. If you know how to turn LinkedIn + Email + AI automation into a predictable meeting pipeline, this role is for you. You will own the entire outbound motion — from ICP research and list building to messaging, campaign execution, optimization, and meeting generation. Your success will be measured by qualified meetings and pipeline created. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys experimentation, speed, and performance-driven marketing. What You’ll Own 1. Outbound Campaign Strategy • Design multi-touch outbound campaigns across LinkedIn and cold email • Define ICPs, buyer personas, and targeting strategies • Build scalable outreach sequences that generate qualified meetings 2. List Building & Targeting • Identify and build high-quality prospect databases • Use AI tools and automation to filter irrelevant prospects and refine targeting • Continuously improve ICP accuracy and campaign targeting 3. Campaign Execution • Run and manage LinkedIn outreach campaigns • Execute cold email sequences with personalization • Launch and optimize multi-touch outbound campaigns 4. Messaging & Personalization • Write high-performing outbound messaging • Personalize outreach at scale using AI and automation tools • Continuously test new messaging angles 5. AI-Powered Outreach Systems You must be extremely comfortable using AI and automation tools to improve speed and campaign performance. This includes: • ICP research and targeting • Filtering and cleaning prospect lists • Generating personalized outreach messages • Campaign automation • Performance analysis and optimization 6. Campaign Analytics & Optimization • Track campaign performance metrics including: • Open rates • Reply rates • Meeting conversion • Pipeline contribution • Continuously optimize campaigns based on data Ideal Candidate Profile • 2+ years experience running outbound lead generation campaigns • Strong experience with LinkedIn outreach and cold email campaigns • Preferably worked with B2B technology companies / SaaS / IT services • Proven track record of generating qualified meetings through outbound • Strong understanding of B2B buyer psychology and messaging • Highly comfortable using AI tools and automation to scale outreach • Analytical and highly execution-driven Tools You May Have Used • LinkedIn Sales Navigator • Apollo • Instantly • Lemlist • Clay • PhantomBuster • HubSpot / Salesforce • Zapier / Make • ChatGPT / Claude / AI writing tools What We Value Most We care less about titles and more about results. You will thrive in this role if you: • Think like a growth hacker • Move fast and experiment constantly • Care deeply about pipeline impact • Use AI and automation to work 10x faster Why Join Blufig • Work with fast-growing B2B technology companies globally • Be part of a high-performance marketing team • Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI-powered outreach systems • Direct exposure to founders, marketing leaders, and GTM teams • High ownership and autonomy in your role • Opportunity to experiment, innovate, and build scalable growth engines Benefits • Competitive compensation based on capability • Salary credited on last day of the month – Always • Company paid health insurance for you and your family • Exposure to global B2B technology clients • Opportunity to work with modern marketing and AI tools • Collaborative team culture • 5-day work week Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
title: GTM & Outbound Growth Specialist

description: Deine Aufgaben Du möchtest die Digitalisierung der Verwaltung mitgestalten und deine innovativen Ideen im Rahmen eines agilen Arbeitsumfelds einbringen? Als Product Owner (m/w/d) begleitest du zusammen mit deinem Team und den Kunden die Anforderungserhebung und Umsetzung bis hin zum Release und der Weiterentwicklung einer Softwareanwendung. Mit einem Projekt zum Aufbau der Kommunikationsinfrastruktur im Rahmen der Digitalisierung der Verwaltung hilfst du dabei den digitalen Wandel zu meistern und aktiv voranzutreiben. Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden und Entwicklungsteam und übersetzt Bedürfnisse in umsetzbare Anforderungen. Du analysierst neue Anforderungen und leitest daraus User Stories ab. Du erarbeitest zusammen mit Team und Kunden das Product Backlog und laufende Sprint Ziele und Releases. Du bist Hauptansprechperson für unsere Kunden und überzeugst dabei mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit deinem Team die Qualitätssicherung und die verlässliche Auslieferung neuer Funktionen und Releases. Du arbeitest eng mit weiteren Teams, Teilprojekten und Consultants zusammen. Das bringst du mit Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, vorzugsweise im technischen Umfeld Analytisches Denken und Freude daran, sich in komplexe Themen strukturiert einzuarbeiten Teamorientierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und dem Team Klare, verständliche und proaktive Kommunikation Erste Erfahrung als Product Owner, bevorzugt in agilen Softwareentwicklungsprojekten Reisebereitschaft und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) Das bieten wir dir Du bist Teil eines spannenden Projekts im Bereich der Digitalisierung der Verwaltung und kannst dich mit deinen kreativen Ideen einbringen. Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten, agilen Team mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, das dir den Einstieg leicht macht. Du entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich weiter in einer modernen Arbeitsumgebung mit starken Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Eine starke Work Life Balance sowie umfassende Benefits für dich und deine Familie runden unser Angebot ab. Kontakt Andre Lämmlen , HR Manager karriere@seitenbau.com Jonas Moser , HR Manager karriere@seitenbau.com Marie Braun , HR Manager karriere@seitenbau.com Über uns SEITENBAU ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen, das es seit 1996 gibt. Bei SEITENBAU arbeiten mehr als 300 kreative Köpfe an verschiedensten Softwarelösungen in Scrum Teams. Offene Kommunikation, vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit und eine gesunde Mischung aus Praxisbewährtem und cutting edge - das ist das Credo, nach dem wir erfolgreich und mit Spaß arbeiten. Falls du noch mehr über SEITENBAU erfahren möchtest - und das aus Mitarbeitersicht- besuch doch mal unsere kununu Seite.
title: Product Owner / Technical Consultant (m/w/d) – Konstanz, Berlin oder remote

description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Performance-Marketing-Workstreams von Enpal – mit direkter Sichtbarkeit auf C-Level-Ebene. Du entwickelst und skalierst datengetriebene Performance-Marketing-Strategien über verschiedene Paid-Kanäle, um nachhaltiges Wachstum und eine effiziente Neukundengewinnung sicherzustellen. Du analysierst Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und steuerst Budgets mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierung, Profitabilität und Performance. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product, Data, Operations und dem C-Level zusammen, um Wachstumshebel zu identifizieren, Experimente umzusetzen und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Growth Teams und gestaltest den Ausbau eines strategisch wichtigen Geschäftsbereichs mit direktem Einfluss auf Enpals zukünftiges Wachstum Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium an einer Top-Universität oder ein vergleichbarer Leistungsnachweis. 0–2 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, Paid Acquisition, Digital Marketing oder in der Strategieberatung mit Fokus auf Growth, Marketing oder Commercial Excellence. Erste nachweisbare Erfolge in der Planung, Steuerung oder Skalierung von Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen (z. B. Meta, Google, TikTok oder andere Paid-Kanäle) sind ein großes Plus. Unternehmerisches Mindset, hohe Eigenverantwortung und die Fähigkeit, Themen von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Skalierung voranzutreiben. Analytisches Denken, ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und ein datengetriebener Arbeitsstil mit Fokus auf KPIs, Experimente und kontinuierliche Optimierung. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, bereichsübergreifend mit Marketing, Product, Data und Operations zusammenzuarbeiten. Du denkst groß, handelst schnell, hinterfragst den Status quo und probierst neue Ansätze aus – mit dem Anspruch, Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu schaffen. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.
title: Associate Strategy & Growth (w/m/d)

description: The decisions that shape everyday life: Every day, the world's largest consumer companies make decisions that shape what billions of people eat, drink, clean with, and care for their families with. What product to launch. How to design the packaging. Whether an innovation is ready for a new market. The companies making these decisions want to understand their consumers deeply. But the tools available to them are slow, expensive, and limited in who they can reach. The result is that some of the most consequential product decisions on the planet are made with incomplete understanding of the people they are meant to serve. We believe that every consumer deserves to be understood, and every company making products for them deserves the tools to make that possible. We are solving that gap. What we are building: We’re building AI-native research infrastructure that lets companies talk to, observe, and understand consumers at a speed and depth that wasn’t possible before. Imagine AI conducting a 90-minute conversation with a consumer, observing how they interact with a product in their home, catching contradictions between what they say and do, and turning all of it into structured insight for a global product team by the next morning. We’re backed by Neon Fund and Titan Capital and growing fast with enterprise customers globally, including P&G, Coca-Cola, Haleon, Kantar . Now, we’re looking for someone exceptional to help build the next phase of growth. What you will own: You’ll work closely with the founders across sales, growth and marketing. That could mean: Building relationships with senior leaders at some of the world’s largest companies Creating outreach and campaigns that open doors Owning opportunities from first conversation through conversion Building decks, videos, content and customer stories that make people pay attention Helping shape how Echovane is positioned and taken to market Experimenting with new growth ideas and using AI to execute faster The scope will evolve quickly. If something can meaningfully move the company forward, you should be excited to own it. You are a fit if you: Have 3+ years of experience across sales, growth, marketing, founder’s office or another high-ownership role Are highly customer-centric and understand what builds trust and moves conversations forward Have great taste -  you care about how an email, deck, video, event or piece of content is written, designed and experienced Are a builder who enjoys creating things from zero rather than following an established playbook Communicate exceptionally well and can make complex ideas simple Own outcomes , not just tasks Have high agency - you see gaps, figure things out and push things forward Move fast and have a strong bias toward action Are ambitious, deeply motivated and excited about AI, consumer businesses and company building Why Echovane: You’ll get the chance to: Take frontier AI into some of the world’s largest enterprises Build the growth engine , not inherit one Work directly with founders with experience across Amazon, Stripe and Razorpay Build relationships with VPs, Heads of Insights, Innovation leaders and executives behind some of the world’s biggest brands Own meaningful work from day one Learn across enterprise sales, growth, marketing, AI product positioning and company building This is a role for someone who wants significantly more ownership than their years of experience would normally give them. Someone ambitious, thoughtful, resourceful, and relentless about doing great work.

description: MISSION Retail Investors across the world are ready to build wealth, but lack research & advice they can trust. StockGro is fixing that. As India's leading stock market advisory and research platform, StockGro connect 35M+ users with 150+ SEBI-registered experts and our proprietary Stoxo AI. On our platform, users access research-backed trade ideas and turn complex stock market data into simple, actionable insights; facilitating research, backtesting and trade execution on one platform. We are also expanding our intelligent investing infrastructure across GCC, starting with the UAE. We were featured among CB Insights Top 100 Fintechs globally (2023) and highlighted by the World Economic Forum (2026) for driving financial inclusion through AI (2026). ABOUT STOCKGRO Founded in 2020 by Ajay Lakhotia (former VC and seasoned entrepreneur), StockGro set out to solve a fundamental gap: making trusted, high-quality investment advice accessible to everyone. Today, we are India's largest stock market advisory and research platform, empowering over 35 million users to invest smartly. Backed by Global Leaders We have raised ~$110M from marquee investors including BITKRAFT Ventures, General Catalyst, SBI Investments (Japan), and Roots Ventures, with early backing from angels like Kunal Shah, Vivekananda Hallekere, and Rahul Garg. Driven by High-Density Talent Our team includes senior leaders from Sequoia, Swiggy, Glance, Airtel, and Uber, alongside alumni from ISB, the IIMs, and the NITs. Together, we are building an AI-powered investment intelligence stack and scaling our footprint across the GCC to make smart investments universally accessible. Why Join Us? You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors. Your role in our vison : We don't need someone who clutters a user's inbox with just another push notification or in-app prompt. We need someone whose messages get opened - because they're relevant, well-timed, and worth the user's attention. That means ensuring users actually understand what we're building, how our features work, and why this should be their go-to product for investing - not just that we told them it exists, but that they get it. This is a high-visibility role responsible for ensuring that users who activate on the platform stay engaged, deepen their relationship with us, and grow into high-value customers. What We Offer: We're a lean, close-knit team without rigid departmental walls. You'll have direct ownership over growth outcomes, not just a slice of a funnel. You'll work directly with the leadership on a product used by retail investors in India, with real autonomy to test and ship ideas fast. What You'll Own Growth & Experimentation Drive & own product adoption journeys through targeted channels once user cohorts are locked Lead data-backed user journey analysis and A/B testing and not assumptions or bias. Identify funnel drop-offs and opportunities for wins. Partner with product to surface high-intent traffic patterns and feedback that drive stickiness and retention Lifecycle & Automation Execute playbooks that activate users to new/existing features via in-app messaging, campaigns, and other communication channels as appropriate Design and build end-to-end lifecycle sequences for users at different stages - from Acquisition through Revenue - with messaging and formats that hit at the right moment Performance & Optimization Track and close loops on all triggered campaigns and automation workflows using rigorous metrics and data - not experimentation without measurement Turn funnel analysis into specific, actionable recommendations for the product team (not just reporting dashboards) Optimise spend and effectiveness across push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and in-app prompts -with revenue metrics as the north star What You Bring Strong inclination towards capital markets - you understand trading behavior and how retail investors actually use these products. This matters more than years of experience. 4+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, or similar Hands-on experience analyzing funnels, user journeys, and turning data into action Proficiency with CRM/marketing automation tools - WebEngage, MoEngage, CleverTap, or similar A sharp analytical mindset paired with genuine creative instincts Comfort with ambiguity and ownership in a lean, fast-moving team
